justifications.D1: "If SE_batch_level > 50% of the observed effect, flag the gate as unresolvable" — the wrong-unit and gate-in-noise failures are converted into batch-level detection falsifiers (F2, F3, F5) rather than merely avoided.
justifications.D3: "Early stop if F4 or F5 is triggered during preflight (n_eff < 10 or extreme outlier weights)" — numeric falsifiers F1-F6 with cheap early mechanism-independent preflight kills and an explicit stopping rule.
justifications.D4: "Compute weights under robust covariance estimation ... If they diverge, the effect is sensitive to outliers" — the summary's confounds (unit, heterogeneity, measurement error) each isolated, but no injected-signal positive control demonstrating detection.
justifications.D5: "not only is the unit the batch, but the weighting within the batch-level analysis matters when batch-size and outcome-variance correlate. This is the second-order confound Arm B isolates" — explicit new-cell statement beyond the settled unit correction.
justifications.D6: "Non-null verdicts for F3–F6 are discoveries (heterogeneity, confounding, brittleness), not failures" — every branch pre-committed, including the unresolvable-gate and brittle-inference readings.

justifications.D1: "Compute n_effective (count distinct batches) before any analysis. Use batch-level inference as primary" — the 57x wrong-unit failure is made detectable via F3's pseudoreplication-trap falsifier and the row-level arm demoted to a transparency check.
justifications.D3: "Early stop if F5 is triggered during preflight (n_batches < 10): the experiment is underpowered by design" — numeric falsifiers F1-F5 with a cheap early design-failure kill and explicit stopping rules.
justifications.D4: "Compute SE BEFORE preregistration. Require gate to be >= 2 SE away from plausible values" — each summary confound has a concrete defense (stratification, resolution matching), but there is no positive control demonstrating the pipeline detects real signal.
justifications.D5: "Batch-level analysis reveals the effect is weaker or disappears compared to naive per-row inference" — applies the settled clustered-SE correction to a new planned experiment with a moderation extension, without an explicit new-cell statement.
justifications.D6: "Verdict: no statistically detectable effect (inconclusive on power, not on magnitude)" — F1-F5 map every branch with pre-committed vacuous/unresolvable and design-failure readings.

justifications.D1: "148-L demonstrates that fixing the unit-of-analysis defect is necessary but was NOT sufficient" — both summary failures (wrong unit, fold dominance/memorization) are converted into the inflation-ratio readout, jackknife dominance gate, and hard held-out replication gate.
justifications.D3: "if G (number of batches) < 20, the analytic CR2 SE alone is insufficient; the wild cluster bootstrap CI must also exclude the null" — numeric falsifiers 1-5 with a cheap early cluster-count floor and an interim dominance stop.
justifications.D4: "inject a batch-level effect of known magnitude into a held-out synthetic corpus ... verify the pipeline recovers it" — every summary confound addressed plus an explicit positive control demonstrating detection of real signal.
justifications.D5: "they are preregistered here as this task's own gate, not as an imported validated constant" — explicitly states the new batch-decision-substrate cell beyond the 147-K/148-L precedents.
justifications.D6: "reclassified FOLD_DOMINANCE_ARTIFACT ... RETRACTED, full stop ... INCONCLUSIVE_INSUFFICIENT_CLUSTERS" — every branch maps to a named, pre-committed verdict including the no-effect and underpowered readings.

justifications.D1: "Forbidden quantity, stated explicitly: any SE computed as if N = total row count. Its presence in a report is treated as a defect" — the wrong-unit failure is converted into hard-coded assertions plus gate-fire worlds that reproduce the inflation where the truth is known.
justifications.D3: "If, in the null gate-fire world, the batch-bootstrap empirical coverage of the 95% BCa interval falls below 90% ... the bootstrap implementation is rejected" — a cheap early mechanism-independent falsifier plus numeric falsifiers 2-4 and a pilot-based stopping rule.
justifications.D4: "Three gate-fire synthetic worlds, run and passing before any real batch is analyzed" — batch-size, nesting, and autocorrelation confounds each defended, with null, deterministic-copy, and planted-correlation positive controls.
justifications.D5: "the specific risk here ... is new territory, not a re-run of either precedent — hence this is a design specification, not a replication" — explicit statement of the new cell (widely varying batch sizes, dual estimands).
justifications.D6: "the result is marked UNDECIDED pending more batches, never rounded to a side" — every branch, including the methods-agree reversion (falsifier 2) and no-CI readings, is pre-committed.
